Ines Pereira  
Email: ines.pereira@email.com | Phone: +91 9876543210 | Location: Hyderabad, India | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/inespereira  

As a Tech Lead at VirtuTech Solutions, I have focused on streamlining cross-functional workflows and optimizing cloud infrastructure. My role has involved leading a team of five to deliver scalable solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals through structured project management. Prior to this, I contributed to backend development and cloud setup at NexaCorp, where I gained hands-on experience with AWS services. As a Junior Software Engineer, I supported REST API design and participated in agile sprint planning, which laid the foundation for my current leadership responsibilities.  

**Technical Skills**  
Leveraged AWS for cloud infrastructure deployment, including EC2 instances and S3 storage, during my internship at NexaCorp. Utilized Terraform to automate resource provisioning, reducing manual configuration time by 30% in my current role. Integrated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring automated testing and deployment for multiple microservices. Designed scalable system architectures, emphasizing modular components and API gateways, which improved service response times by 20%. Managed cross-team integration projects, coordinating with DevOps and QA teams to resolve dependencies. Optimized cloud costs by 15% through resource tagging and reserved instance strategies.  

**Projects**  
Led a project to refactor legacy monolithic applications into containerized microservices, resulting in a 25% reduction in deployment downtime. Collaborated with stakeholders to define requirements and communicated progress through weekly demos, ensuring alignment with business priorities. Streamlined stakeholder communication by implementing a centralized documentation portal, improving transparency across teams.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science (Computer Science), University of Technology, 2023.  

**Languages**  
English (fluent), Hindi (proficient).  

**Certifications**  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2023). Scrum Master (CSM), Scrum Alliance (2022).
